label: unstated
reason: The docstring only describes replacing code with -CODE- and gives a paragraph example; it never says list items get a "[-]" prefix, so a programmer would likely output "Item 1!" rather than "[-]Item 1!".
missing: The docstring should say that each non-empty list item (in ul/ol) is prefixed with "[-]", and that a period is appended if the item text does not already end in punctuation.
